Human cortical microvasculature

Explore blood vessels segmented from electron microscopy of a single human temporal cortex specimen.

49,364 cell bodies · 1,463 vessel segments · 110,484 vessel voxels

Sample and resolution

Amber points mark occupied voxels in the H01 vessel mask at 4.096 × 4.096 × 4.224 µm sampling. Cyan points mark centroids of individual H01 cell-body masks sampled at 2.048 × 2.048 × 2.112 µm. Cell and vessel IDs belong to separate source layers. A label identifies a segmented piece. One vessel can span multiple labels. Both atlas models open this same independent specimen.

Derived from the H01 release by the Lichtman Laboratory at Harvard and Connectomics at Google. Vessel voxel locations and cell-body centroids were extracted from the two source masks and assigned display colors.
